description:
Use this when the user asks to report a problem with DalalOS data or tools, or to request a feature, or agrees after you offer to report a likely DalalOS issue. Not for questions about a company; it sends a report to the DalalOS team and does not change any data.

Submit a user-approved report about DalalOS data, tools, documentation, or a feature request. Use this when the user asks to report feedback or agrees after you offer. Include only details needed to understand the issue; do not send full conversations, credentials, account information, contact details, portfolio holdings, or unrelated private data. Clearly distinguish a suspected issue from a verified fact: a reported discrepancy is stored as a claim, since units, periods or source timing may explain it. Never report a failure of this feedback tool itself, and do not offer to report the same issue twice in one conversation.

Fields: `category` (data_inaccurate, data_outdated, data_missing, tool_error, unexpected_result, feature_request, documentation, other), `summary` (max 160 chars), `details` (what happened or what is needed, max 2000 chars) and `request_id` (a fresh UUID you generate per report; reuse it only to retry the same report) are required. Optional context: `related_tool` (the DalalOS tool involved), `security_identifier` with `security_identifier_type` (nse_symbol, bse_code or isin; give both or neither), `metric`, `observed_value` and `expected_value` (with units, max 200 chars each), `as_of_date` (date or reporting period), `source_reference` (a short citation or URL; it is stored, never fetched). No source, exact value or identifier is required.

Requires an authenticated caller. Feedback is free and does not use monthly credits. On success returns `report_id` and `status` "received" (the report was saved; it has not been verified, prioritised or fixed). Tell the user the report supports future improvements, that the team will not reply to individual reports for now, and give them the report ID. If the call fails, say the report was not saved; you may offer to retry with the same `request_id`.
name: submit_dalalos_feedback
title: Send DalalOS feedback
